title: 3-dimensional TQFTs from derived categories of quantum group representations
summary: For any finite modular tensor category A, we show that the associated derived $\infty$-category D(A) supports a topological quantum field theory in dimension 3. This TQFT takes the form of a symmetric monoidal functor from an $\infty$-category of surfaces with markings by objects in D(A), and appropriately decorated bordisms, to the $\infty$-category of dg vector spaces. We show that the state spaces in this theory are naturally identified with linearized mapping spaces for D(A).
